newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS MONDAY A TOUCH WEAKER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS MONDAY A TOUCH WEAKER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted slightly weaker against hard currencies on Monday morning from Friday's closing levels but dealers expected it to hold largely steady in quiet trade the rest of the day.

"There was a little bit of buying this morning but I don't expect much more movement in the exchange rates today. We're expecting some export inflows so the local dollar should stabilise at these levels or slightly above," one dealer predicted.
At around 0730 GMT the Zimbabwe unit was trading a notch easier on the U.S. currency at 11.3050/3150 compared to Friday's 11.3025/3125.

Against the crosses it also lost ground; to 18.3025/3245 from 18.2739/3014 against sterling, to 6.7060/7140 from 6.6811/6900 on the mark and to 2.5330/5370 against South Africa's rand from 2.5325/5364.
